steps.name: Install pinned Rust and iOS standard library
Type check the optional carrier provider for physical iPhone
Check all native bridge files against the simulator SDK
Build and bundle the standard UIKit application
Build and bundle the optional carrier provider
Cache the successfully built UIKit application
Verify native UI, device roundtrips and activation

native_build: Standard and ios26-telephony simulator bundles, physical-iPhone Swift carrier typecheck and both Objective-C feature configurations passed. Runtime used the optional carrier bundle without signed dialer/SMS eligibility.

checks.name: network_path_observed
checks.semantics: network path availability, not Internet reachability

controls.detail: The simulator reports a brightness value but has no writable physical backlight.
This device has no rear torch.
Use the native volume panel. iOS does not provide a general writable system volume property.
Choose an available output in the system route picker.
The native route picker chooses compatible audio/video destinations for the app; it does not enable system screen mirroring.
Low Power Mode is observed from iOS. Change it in the system Settings app.

snapshot.detail: Public UIKit device integrations. Contacts respect the selected access scope; message composition reports the actual system composer outcome. Device controls reflect observed hardware and permissions.

roles.detail: The running device/build does not have an eligible signed Default Dialer entitlement. The standard calling handoff remains available.
Carrier messaging requires the signed entitlement, an eligible iPhone/region and selection as default. The normal message composer remains separate.

checks.name: brightness_read_only
checks.refusal: Screen brightness is read-only in iOS Simulator.

first_retained_observation.boundary: Both values were already observed in the first retained Start snapshot. No earlier Unknown value or native suspension transition was retained in this run; those lifetime paths have portable regression coverage.

network_scope: The actual true value reports Network.framework path availability, not Internet or remote service reachability.
visual_review: Fresh Start, restored Start, Search and native button crops were inspected. All eleven full-screen captures have identical decoded Back/Start/Search cells with 535/1860/464 bright opaque pixels. The gray 34-point strip is the UIKit safe area below the 54-point navigation row. This qualifies this run, not general visual parity.
navigation_timestamp_boundary: All retained route observations follow the actual tap start and request. The first Search observation occurs 82 ms before XCUIElement.tap returns, while that call is still awaiting idle; its completed driver receipt was also required before the shell accepted the route.
readiness_boundary: Measured from the shell launch phase to first URL delivery after observing driver ready, including launch setup and polling. The existing 240-second budget was retained.

console_driver_begin.liveness_source: Shell kill -0 of its direct simctl launch child; not native application liveness.

console_driver_end.liveness_source: Shell kill -0 of its direct simctl launch child; not native application liveness.

cleanup.boundary: The XCTest test completed and the shell successfully waited for its owned xcodebuild driver. Its simctl console child changed from running to not_running. Application termination and simulator deletion were requested but not independently proved by a post-cleanup native PID or simulator inventory; the last mounted observation is not a closed-host receipt.
